verdict.rationale: Agora's own materials describe a voice-agent pipeline that plugs any LLM into a choice of ASR and TTS for real-time voice conversations. The docs also point to a minimal backend-plus-client flow for getting a voice agent running, and Agora runs the live voice sessions this pipeline would attach to. The pipeline claim comes from the marketing homepage, though, and no step-by-step documentation shows how a live channel session is wired into the STT→LLM→TTS chain, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the session-to-agent integration path (how the agent joins or attaches to a live channel), specifics on configuring the STT/LLM/TTS providers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech

citations.quote: Integrate any LLM or existing AI agent with your choice of ASR and TTS, to enable real-time voice conversations, with interruption handling, noise suppression and a natural flow.
Build the minimal backend-plus-client flow and get a working voice agent running quickly.
Voice calls, video calls, interactive live streaming, and broadcast streaming sessions.
